# Apex Client Beta 1.0.0

## Features
- Custom Minecraft launcher based on Prism Launcher
- Automatic Apex Client mod installation for Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric
- User detection to see other Apex Client users in-game
- Seamless Microsoft authentication

## Getting Started
1. Download and install Apex Client
2. Log in with your Microsoft account
3. Create a new Minecraft 1.21.11 instance with Fabric loader
4. The Apex Client mod will be automatically installed!
